units.source_text: 我把安眠药和短刀全然忘却了。

en.t: I had completely forgotten about the sleeping pills and the dagger.

units.source_text: 我突然产生了"要在烈火包围中的究竟顶里死去"的想法。

en.t: Suddenly the thought came to me that I would die inside the Kukkyocho, surrounded by raging flames.

units.source_text: 于是，我从火中遁达，登上了狭窄的阶梯。

en.t: So I escaped through the fire and climbed the narrow stairs.

units.source_text: 潮音洞的门为什么敞开？

en.t: Why was the door of the Choon-do standing open?

units.source_text: 原来是老向导忘记关二楼的门。

en.t: It turned out that the old guide had forgotten to close the door on the second floor.
